title: 第5章 诈尸了第6章 噩梦中的脚印
slug: 梦中强吻女帝被找上门了怎么办
content_zh:
随着江晨一声轻哼，小伙计蓦地就觉得双手传来一股钻心的剧痛，疼得他冷汗直冒，忍不住呼出声来：“哎呀，哎呀——”
“就你这点三脚猫功夫，是怎么敢杀人的？”江晨淡淡地问道。
“我没杀人——”小伙计眼珠急转，正要为自己开脱，忽见江晨手腕一扭，拧得他惨呼连连，“哎哟，痛！痛！痛！”
“老实交代！”
“小子你知道我是谁吗？你敢这样对我！我赵昊是天命之子！有大气运加身！你这样对我会遭报应的！”
“哦？多大的气运？让我见识见识？”江晨手上加重了力道。
“诶呀，轻点轻点……小杂种你等着，今日之辱，我赵昊必加倍奉还！三十年河东——”
“忒多废话！到底说不说？”
“我说！我说！”小伙计疼得眼泪鼻涕都出来了，忙不迭地叫道，“我也不是故意要杀冬雪姑娘，昨天中午收房的时候，我看她衣衫不整地躺在床上，好像被人迷晕了，我一时色迷心窍，就，就……”
“这么说来，是「弄月公子」先迷晕了她，完事之后，又让你捡了便宜？”
“这也不能怪我，西辽城第一美女躺在床上，哪个男人能忍得住？换成是你，你忍得住吗？凭什么「弄月公子」尝得，我赵昊就尝不得？”
“你这畜生，捡了便宜也就算了，为何还要害人性命？”
“我也不是故意的！但没想到正在兴头上的时候，她忽然醒了过来！我一时情急，就捂住她的嘴巴和鼻子，没想到下手太重了些，竟然把她掐死了！我真没想要杀人啊……”
小伙计哭得一把鼻涕一把泪，嘴里嘶嘶直抽冷气。
江晨稍微放松了手上的力道，淡淡地道：“不管你是不是故意，都害了冬雪姑娘性命。而且事后还想栽赃嫁祸给我，被我识破之后，仍不知悔改，还要杀我灭口……你自己说说，应该怎么处置？”
“我错了！我知道错了！我真的错了！我认罪！我愿意去衙门自首……”
小伙计满口认错，心里却在发狠：现在先服软，只要一出这个门，就马上去使钱贿赂衙门里的官爷，把这个“弄月公子”的凶手身份做实，那么大一笔悬赏，就不信官爷们不心动！
忍一时风平浪静，退一步海阔天空！君子报仇，十年不晚！
江晨仿佛被小伙计认错的诚意打动，盯着他的眼睛问道：“真的知错了？”
“真的知错了！以后再也不敢了！”小伙计如小鸡啄米般点头。

“那好，这样一来，也算是死得明白了……”
小伙计听着江晨的语气不太对劲，刚要张嘴求饶，就见江晨捡起地上的匕首，用力捅进了小伙计的咽喉！
小伙计躲闪不及，眼睛瞪得老大，几乎不敢相信这个事实。
他昨天才尝过冬雪姑娘的滋味，堪称人间第一极乐，今天却就要死了吗？
他明明是天命之子，有大气运加身的啊！
这外地小子只不过是个卑贱的无名之辈，是我崛起道路上的垫脚石，他怎么敢杀我！
他怎么敢？！
江晨松开手掌，任由小伙计摔倒在地，在地上挣扎抽搐着，口鼻冒出血沫。
“好了，我俩的账算清了，现在我原谅你了。接下来你去阴间找冬雪姑娘，争取让她也原谅你吧。”
江晨一直觉得，上一世有句话说得好：“我们没有资格代替受害者原谅凶手，我们的任务，就是送凶手下去见受害人。”至于原不原谅，那是他们两人之间的事情了。
更何况，此子心狠手辣，诡计多端，断不可留！
“虫老……救……我……”小伙计捂着脖子，张大嘴巴，拼命喘息。
江晨俯下身子，问道：“你说什么？”
“虫……老……嘶……嘶……”小伙计的嗓音逐渐虚弱。
江晨皱起眉头：“虫老？你还有帮手？”
content_en:
As Jiang Chen snorted, the boy suddenly felt a sharp pain in his hands. The pain made him break into a cold sweat and he couldn't help but exhale: "Oh, oh -"
"With your three-legged cat skills, how dare you kill someone?" Jiang Chen asked calmly.
"I didn't kill anyone -" the boy's eyes quickly turned, and he was about to excuse himself when Jiang Chen suddenly twisted his wrist, causing him to scream miserably, "Oh, it hurts! It hurts! It hurts!"
"Be honest!"
"Boy, do you know who I am? How dare you treat me like this! I, Zhao Hao, am the son of destiny! I am blessed with great luck! You will get retribution for treating me like this!"
"Oh? How much luck? Let me see it?" Jiang Chen increased his strength on his hands.
"Hey, please be gentle... Little bastard, just wait. I, Zhao Hao, will repay you twice as much for today's humiliation! Thirty years from Hedong——"
"What nonsense! Do you want to say it or not?"
"I say! I say!" The young man shouted in a hurry with tears and runny eyes coming from the pain, "I didn't mean to kill Miss Dongxue. When I checked in the room at noon yesterday, I saw her lying disheveled on the bed, as if she had been dazed. I was so fascinated by it, just, just..."
"So, it was "Mr. Nong Yue" who stunned her first, and then let you take advantage of her? "
"You can't blame me. The most beautiful woman in Xiliao City is lying on the bed. Which man can bear it? If it were you, would you be able to bear it? Why can "Master Nong Yue" taste it, but I, Zhao Hao, can't? "
“You beast, you just took advantage of it, why do you want to kill people? "
"I didn't mean it either! But she didn't expect that when she was in the mood, she suddenly woke up! I was so anxious that I covered her mouth and nose. Unexpectedly, I hit her too hard and strangled her to death! I really didn’t want to kill someone..."
The boy was crying until he had runny nose and tears, hissing and gasping for air.
Jiang Chen relaxed his grip slightly and said calmly: "Whether you did it intentionally or not, you still killed Miss Dongxue. And afterwards, he wanted to frame me and put the blame on me. After I found out, he still didn't repent and wanted to kill me to silence me... Tell me, how should you deal with it? "
"I was wrong! I know I was wrong! I was really wrong! I plead guilty! I am willing to surrender to the Yamen..."
The boy confessed his mistake, but he was furious in his heart: Now give in, as soon as you leave this door, you will immediately bribe the officials in the yamen with money to prove the identity of the murderer of "Mr. Nong Yue". With such a huge reward, I don't believe that the officials will not be tempted!
Endure the calm for a while and take a step back to open up the world! A gentleman's revenge is never too late!
Jiang Chen seemed to be moved by the boy's sincerity in admitting his mistake, and looked into his eyes and asked, "Do you really realize your mistake? "
"I really realized my mistake! Never again! "The little guy nodded like a chicken pecking at rice.
"Well, in this way, it can be considered a clear death..."
The young man heard that Jiang Chen's tone was not right. Just when he was about to open his mouth to beg for mercy, he saw Jiang Chen picked up the dagger on the ground and stabbed it into the young man's throat!
The little boy couldn't dodge, his eyes were wide open, and he could hardly believe this fact.
He just tasted the taste of Miss Dongxue yesterday, which is the greatest bliss in the world, but is he going to die today?
He is obviously the son of destiny, blessed with great luck!
This foreign boy is just a lowly and unknown person, a stepping stone on the road to my rise. How dare he kill me!
How dare he? !
Jiang Chen let go of his hand and let the boy fall to the ground, struggling and twitching, with blood foaming from his mouth and nose.
"Okay, our accounts have been settled, and now I forgive you. Next, you go to the underworld to find Miss Dongxue and try to get her to forgive you. "
Jiang Chen always felt that there was a saying in his previous life that said: "We are not qualified to forgive the murderer on behalf of the victim. Our mission is to send the murderer to see the victim. "toIf Yu Yuan doesn't forgive, that's a matter between the two of them.
What's more, this guy is cruel and scheming, so he must not be left here!
"Old Chong... help... me..." The boy covered his neck, opened his mouth wide, and gasped desperately.
Jiang Chen leaned down and asked, "What did you say?"
"Insect... old... hiss... hiss..." the young boy's voice gradually weakened.
Jiang Chen frowned: "Old Chong? Do you still have helpers?"
